papers.title: Dependence-aware aggregation maps shared genetic architecture across cardiovascular traits
papers.summary:
-  We classified 542 files: 194 data, 248 code, 74 documentation, 2 materials, 2 output, 22 unknown.
-  We found 176 tabular data files and extracted 3244 columns from 160 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex1), plus 8 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  16 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (env/R_packages.tsv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; explorer/site/data/build_version.txt: the file has no data rows or columns; inputs/EXTERNAL_INPUT_CHECKSUMS.tsv: 80% of columns are free text, not variables; inputs/literature/COMPARATOR_SOURCE_MANIFEST.tsv: 92% of columns are free text, not variables; provenance/stage3_finngen/run_records_20261104/DEVIATIONS.tsv: 83% of columns are free text, not variables; provenance/stage3_finngen/run_records_20261104/INPUT_AND_BUILD_AUDIT.tsv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; results/core/seed_membership_differences_C.tsv: 50% of columns are free text and 50% are mostly empty -- this looks like a coding worksheet, not a rectangular dataset; tests/expected_intermediate_sha256.tsv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0.zip/ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0/env/R_packages.tsv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0.zip/ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0/explorer/site/data/build_version.txt: the file has no data rows or columns; ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0.zip/ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0/inputs/EXTERNAL_INPUT_CHECKSUMS.tsv: 80% of columns are free text, not variables; ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0.zip/ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0/inputs/literature/COMPARATOR_SOURCE_MANIFEST.tsv: 92% of columns are free text, not variables; ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0.zip/ctas-cardiovascular-v1.0.0/provenance/stage3_finngen/run_records_20261104/DEVIATIONS.tsv: 83% of columns are free text, not variables; papers.summary:
-  We classified 86 files: 82 data, 2 code, 2 documentation.
-  We found 82 tabular data files and extracted 571 columns from 80 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 2 study groups (ex1, ex2), plus 1 collection-level file (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  2 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (06_6f_wx_fit_summary.csv: 75% of columns are free text, not variables; Table1_sample_characteristics.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: 06_6f_wx_fit_summary.csv, Table1_sample_characteristics.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 571 columns; 1 column has at least one potential issue (1 column with leading/trailing whitespace). We detected demographic column for Age.

papers.title: Seven replicated genomic associations of myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME/CFS): a biobank study
papers.summary:
-  We classified 293 files: 31 data, 95 code, 58 documentation, 46 materials, 63 unknown.
-  We found 31 tabular data files and extracted 1462 columns from 31 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 3 study groups (ex1, ex2, ex3), plus 3 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata). We ran automated data-quality checks on 1462 columns; 277 columns have at least one potential issue (262 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 13 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 1 column with numeric values stored as text; 1 column with leading/trailing whitespace). We detected demographic column for Gender.

papers.title: El Nino Southern Oscillation shapes cholera in Africa
papers.summary:
-  We could not list every file of 1 repository, so the checks did not see all its files: R/S (could not be listed: invalid or inaccessible GitHub repository).
-  We classified 678 files: 132 data, 521 code, 13 documentation, 3 materials, 1 output, 8 unknown.
-  We found 127 tabular data files and extracted 1440 columns from 106 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 3 study groups (ex1, ex2, ex3), plus 9 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  4 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (function_renames.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; D11_enso_exposure_by_track.csv: 71% of columns are free text, not variables; D28_software_session.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; T1a_enso_rain_mechanisms.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: function_renames.csv, D11_enso_exposure_by_track.csv, D28_software_session.csv, T1a_enso_rain_mechanisms.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 1440 columns; 7 columns have at least one potential issue (5 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 2 columns with numeric values stored as text). 1 of 1 spreadsheet file has at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: Clinical Prediction Model Performance Metrics Cluster at Arbitrary Thresholds and are Incorrectly Reported in High-Ranking Journals: An Observational Meta-Research Study
papers.summary:
-  We classified 520 files: 292 data, 50 code, 4 documentation, 172 materials, 2 unknown.
-  We found 292 tabular data files and extracted 1656 columns from 286 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 3 study groups (ex1, ex2, pilot1), plus 2 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  6 R workspace files (`.RData`/`.rda`) contain no reusable tabular data — only fitted models or saved session objects. Such files need R (and the exact packages used) to open and are not machine-readable. Share the underlying data as CSV (or a documented `.sav`/`.dta`) with a codebook so it can be reused without R: 02_data/02_pilot/pilot_article.Rdata, 02_data/article.Rdata, 02_data/article_2.Rdata, alexdgibson/cpm_auc-pre_print_release.zip/alexdgibson-cpm_auc-edfcfd2/02_data/02_pilot/pilot_article.Rdata, alexdgibson/cpm_auc-pre_print_release.zip/alexdgibson-cpm_auc-edfcfd2/02_data/article.Rdata, alexdgibson/cpm_auc-pre_print_release.zip/alexdgibson-cpm_auc-edfcfd2/02_data/article_2.Rdata. We ran automated data-quality checks on 1656 columns; 248 columns have at least one potential issue (134 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 42 columns with numeric values stored as text; 30 columns with inconsistent category casing; 24 columns whose values look like personal information; 20 columns of free text that may contain personal detail; 10 columns whose name suggests personal information; 4 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 2 columns whose names become identical when special characters are removed; 2 columns with leading/trailing whitespace).

papers.title: Do Sleep Questionnaires Add Predictive Value Beyond Demographics for Obstructive Sleep Apnea Severity? Evidence from 67,397 Patients
papers.summary:
-  We classified 132 files: 31 data, 61 code, 4 documentation, 2 materials, 34 output.
-  We found 27 tabular data files and extracted 160 columns from 25 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex1), plus 3 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  2 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (table_one_osa_clusters.xlsx: 86% of columns are free text, not variables; S9_auroc_uncertainty.xlsx: 88% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: table_one_osa_clusters.xlsx, S9_auroc_uncertainty.xlsx. We ran automated data-quality checks on 160 columns; 21 columns have at least one potential issue (15 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 6 columns with numeric values stored as text). We detected demographic column for Age. 6 of 10 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).
